g.text: One connected space is our efficiency.
This is how it turns into yours.
We orchestrate because production spread across disconnected tools is slow, and slow is expensive. The time we get back is the time you get back, and the visibility is a side effect you can use.
, and every hand-off is a re-export, a re-brief, a version that drifts, an approval chased by email, or an asset
nobody can find. None of that work appears on any invoice line, and all of it costs time.
MAKE is not your system of record.
Your DAM is. This rail is where work is produced, not where it lives. See slide 09.
One record of versions, review and approval
Open connectors instead of one closed suite
Shorter time from brief to first cut
fewer places for a deliverable to sit still
Status you can see without asking for it
no status calls to find out where something is
Your tools and your DAM stay where they are
no migration, no replacement, no new licences for you
TECHNOLOGY SECTION · STORYBOARD FOR NARRATIVE AGREEMENT
